description: Sprint 75 Task 7 (R-1): WinWright coverage for controls added in Sprints 74-75 -- the Scan Results Sort chip, Scan History Clear history (open and CANCEL only), Settings 'Hide sender details in exports' (toggle and restore), and the resolved folder rows on Settings > Account. SELECTORS VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-03 against dev build 0.17.0. STATE: the Sort chip is screen state (not saved) and is toggled back; the export checkbox is toggled twice, restoring its value (the DB guard compares app_settings by key/value/type, so the new date_modified is not drift -- winwright-db-snapshot.ps1 self-test Step 7b); Clear history is CANCELLED -- its confirm button 'Clear history' deletes every finished scan and must NEVER be targeted (note the confirm is 'Clear history', the toolbar button is 'Clear scan history'; both selectors here are exact-name). Every action is followed by a step that resolves only if the app advanced (README 'A step reporting success proves DISPATCH, not effect'). Each case ends at the home screen. Needs at least one saved scan in Scan History (the dev DB has many).
